-- 渠道日指标 Paimon。bitmap 列存 BINARY，与 SR bitmap_hash64 编码一致。
-- OUT_DB 测试渲染 test，生产渲染 paimon。
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_channel_metrics_daily_d (
    dt                           STRING,
    app_id                       STRING,
    channel                      STRING,
    landing_page_pv              BIGINT,
    landing_page_uv              BINARY,
    landing_page_click_count     BIGINT,
    video_show_from_channel      BIGINT,
    app_entry_count              BIGINT,
    channel_reg_ids              BINARY,
    channel_ios_reg_ids          BINARY,
    channel_android_reg_ids      BINARY,
    channel_pc_reg_ids           BINARY,
    channel_other_reg_ids        BINARY,
    login_all_ids                BINARY,
    login_ios_ids                BINARY,
    login_android_ids            BINARY,
    login_pc_ids                 BINARY,
    login_other_ids              BINARY,
    dau_ids                      BINARY,
    dau_ios_ids                  BINARY,
    dau_android_ids              BINARY,
    dau_pc_ids                   BINARY,
    dau_other_ids                BINARY,
    dau_vip_ids                  BINARY,
    dau_non_vip_ids              BINARY,
    pay_user_ids                 BINARY,
    pay_user_gold_ids            BINARY,
    pay_user_vip_ids             BINARY,
    active_duration_total        BIGINT,
    order_launch_count           BIGINT,
    order_valid_count            BIGINT,
    revenue_total                BIGINT,
    revenue_channel              BIGINT,
    revenue_nature               BIGINT,
    revenue_gold                 BIGINT,
    revenue_vip                  BIGINT,
    user_consume_gold            BIGINT,
    dad_ids                      BINARY,
    dad_ios_ids                  BINARY,
    dad_android_ids              BINARY,
    dad_pc_ids                   BINARY,
    dad_other_ids                BINARY,
    dad_vip_ids                  BINARY,
    dad_no_vip_ids               BINARY
)
USING paimon
PARTITIONED BY (dt);

-- task: ads_channel_metrics_daily_d
-- doc: 渠道日浏览、落地页、视频、注册、登录、活跃、交易与金币消耗，按 app_id×channel 汇总
-- params: DT, OUT_DB

-- 口径对齐现网 ads.ads_channel_metrics_daily_d（海豚 job_ads_channel_metrics_daily_d）
-- 维表读 paimon.dim.dim_user_snap（snap_dt=业务日），不读 dim.dim_user_all
-- 明细读 paimon.dwd 实时表（_r 后缀）；bitmap 用 bm_union / bm_merge / bm_empty
-- 只写 Paimon；SR 影子回写见 pb_ads_channel_metrics_daily_d.sql

SET spark.sql.session.timeZone = Asia/Shanghai;

INSERT OVERWRITE ${OUT_DB}.ads.ads_channel_metrics_daily_d
PARTITION (dt = '${DT}') (
    dt,
    app_id,
    channel,
    landing_page_pv,
    landing_page_uv,
    landing_page_click_count,
    video_show_from_channel,
    app_entry_count,
    channel_reg_ids,
    channel_ios_reg_ids,
    channel_android_reg_ids,
    channel_pc_reg_ids,
    channel_other_reg_ids,
    login_all_ids,
    login_ios_ids,
    login_android_ids,
    login_pc_ids,
    login_other_ids,
    dau_ids,
    dau_ios_ids,
    dau_android_ids,
    dau_pc_ids,
    dau_other_ids,
    dau_vip_ids,
    dau_non_vip_ids,
    pay_user_ids,
    pay_user_gold_ids,
    pay_user_vip_ids,
    active_duration_total,
    order_launch_count,
    order_valid_count,
    revenue_total,
    revenue_channel,
    revenue_nature,
    revenue_gold,
    revenue_vip,
    user_consume_gold,
    dad_ids,
    dad_ios_ids,
    dad_android_ids,
    dad_pc_ids,
    dad_other_ids,
    dad_vip_ids,
    dad_no_vip_ids
)
WITH
uid_attribution AS (
    SELECT
        p.app_id,
        p.uid,
        COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic') AS channel,
        MAX_BY(p.user_type, p.event_time) AS final_user_type,
        MAX_BY(p.device, p.event_time) AS final_device,
        COUNT(1) AS pv_cnt
    FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r p
    LEFT JOIN paimon.dim.dim_user_snap dua
        ON p.app_id = dua.app_id
       AND p.uid = dua.uid
       AND dua.snap_dt = '${DT}'
    WHERE p.dt = '${DT}'
      AND p.uid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.app_id, p.uid, COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic')
),
did_attribution AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        device_id,
        channel,
        MAX_BY(user_type, event_time) AS final_user_type,
        MAX_BY(device, event_time) AS final_device
    FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r
    WHERE dt = '${DT}'
      AND device_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY app_id, device_id, channel
)
SELECT
    '${DT}' AS dt,
    t.app_id,
    t.channel,
    SUM(t.lp_pv) AS landing_page_pv,
    bm_merge(t.lp_uv) AS landing_page_uv,
    SUM(t.lp_click) AS landing_page_click_count,
    SUM(t.video_view) AS video_show_from_channel,
    SUM(t.app_entry) AS app_entry_count,
    bm_merge(t.reg_all) AS channel_reg_ids,
    bm_merge(t.reg_ios) AS channel_ios_reg_ids,
    bm_merge(t.reg_android) AS channel_android_reg_ids,
    bm_merge(t.reg_pc) AS channel_pc_reg_ids,
    bm_merge(t.reg_other) AS channel_other_reg_ids,
    bm_merge(t.login_all_ids) AS login_all_ids,
    bm_merge(t.login_ios_ids) AS login_ios_ids,
    bm_merge(t.login_android_ids) AS login_android_ids,
    bm_merge(t.login_pc_ids) AS login_pc_ids,
    bm_merge(t.login_other_ids) AS login_other_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dau_ids) AS dau_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dau_ios_ids) AS dau_ios_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dau_android_ids) AS dau_android_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dau_pc_ids) AS dau_pc_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dau_other_ids) AS dau_other_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dau_vip_ids) AS dau_vip_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dau_non_vip_ids) AS dau_non_vip_ids,
    bm_merge(t.pay_user_ids) AS pay_user_ids,
    bm_merge(t.pay_user_gold_ids) AS pay_user_gold_ids,
    bm_merge(t.pay_user_vip_ids) AS pay_user_vip_ids,
    SUM(t.active_duration_total) AS active_duration_total,
    SUM(t.order_launch_count) AS order_launch_count,
    SUM(t.order_valid_count) AS order_valid_count,
    SUM(t.revenue_total) AS revenue_total,
    SUM(t.revenue_channel) AS revenue_channel,
    SUM(t.revenue_nature) AS revenue_nature,
    SUM(t.revenue_gold) AS revenue_gold,
    SUM(t.revenue_vip) AS revenue_vip,
    SUM(t.user_consume_gold) AS user_consume_gold,
    bm_merge(t.dad_ids) AS dad_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dad_ios_ids) AS dad_ios_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dad_android_ids) AS dad_android_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dad_pc_ids) AS dad_pc_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dad_other_ids) AS dad_other_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dad_vip_ids) AS dad_vip_ids,
    bm_merge(t.dad_no_vip_ids) AS dad_no_vip_ids
FROM (
    -- A. 落地页访问
    SELECT
        app_id,
        channel,
        COUNT(1) AS lp_pv,
        bm_union(uid) AS lp_uv,
        0 AS lp_click,
        0 AS video_view,
        0 AS app_entry,
        bm_empty() AS reg_all,
        bm_empty() AS reg_ios,
        bm_empty() AS reg_android,
        bm_empty() AS reg_pc,
        bm_empty() AS reg_other,
        bm_empty() AS login_all_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_non_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_gold_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_vip_ids,
        0 AS active_duration_total,
        0 AS order_launch_count,
        0 AS order_valid_count,
        0 AS revenue_total,
        0 AS revenue_channel,
        0 AS revenue_nature,
        0 AS revenue_gold,
        0 AS revenue_vip,
        0 AS user_consume_gold,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_no_vip_ids
    FROM (
        SELECT
            app_id,
            uid,
            CASE
                WHEN channel IS NULL OR channel IN ('', 'self', 'unknown') THEN 'organic'
                ELSE channel
            END AS channel
        FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_landing_page_view_d_r
        WHERE dt = '${DT}'
    ) lpv
    GROUP BY app_id, channel

    UNION ALL

    -- B. 落地页点击
    SELECT
        app_id,
        channel,
        0 AS lp_pv,
        bm_empty() AS lp_uv,
        COUNT(1) AS lp_click,
        0 AS video_view,
        0 AS app_entry,
        bm_empty() AS reg_all,
        bm_empty() AS reg_ios,
        bm_empty() AS reg_android,
        bm_empty() AS reg_pc,
        bm_empty() AS reg_other,
        bm_empty() AS login_all_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_non_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_gold_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_vip_ids,
        0 AS active_duration_total,
        0 AS order_launch_count,
        0 AS order_valid_count,
        0 AS revenue_total,
        0 AS revenue_channel,
        0 AS revenue_nature,
        0 AS revenue_gold,
        0 AS revenue_vip,
        0 AS user_consume_gold,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_no_vip_ids
    FROM (
        SELECT
            app_id,
            CASE
                WHEN channel IS NULL OR channel IN ('', 'self', 'unknown') THEN 'organic'
                ELSE channel
            END AS channel
        FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_landing_page_click_d_r
        WHERE dt = '${DT}'
    ) lpc
    GROUP BY app_id, channel

    UNION ALL

    -- C. 视频事件
    SELECT
        app_id,
        channel,
        0 AS lp_pv,
        bm_empty() AS lp_uv,
        0 AS lp_click,
        COUNT(IF(video_behavior_key = 'video_view', 1, NULL)) AS video_view,
        0 AS app_entry,
        bm_empty() AS reg_all,
        bm_empty() AS reg_ios,
        bm_empty() AS reg_android,
        bm_empty() AS reg_pc,
        bm_empty() AS reg_other,
        bm_empty() AS login_all_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_non_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_gold_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_vip_ids,
        0 AS active_duration_total,
        0 AS order_launch_count,
        0 AS order_valid_count,
        0 AS revenue_total,
        0 AS revenue_channel,
        0 AS revenue_nature,
        0 AS revenue_gold,
        0 AS revenue_vip,
        0 AS user_consume_gold,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_no_vip_ids
    FROM (
        SELECT
            v.app_id,
            v.video_behavior_key,
            COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic') AS channel
        FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_video_event_h_r v
        LEFT JOIN paimon.dim.dim_user_snap dua
            ON v.app_id = dua.app_id
           AND v.uid = dua.uid
           AND dua.snap_dt = '${DT}'
        WHERE v.dt = '${DT}'
    ) v
    GROUP BY app_id, channel

    UNION ALL

    -- D. 应用页面访问（首页进入）
    SELECT
        app_id,
        channel,
        0 AS lp_pv,
        bm_empty() AS lp_uv,
        0 AS lp_click,
        0 AS video_view,
        COUNT(IF(page_key = 'home', 1, NULL)) AS app_entry,
        bm_empty() AS reg_all,
        bm_empty() AS reg_ios,
        bm_empty() AS reg_android,
        bm_empty() AS reg_pc,
        bm_empty() AS reg_other,
        bm_empty() AS login_all_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_non_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_gold_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_vip_ids,
        0 AS active_duration_total,
        0 AS order_launch_count,
        0 AS order_valid_count,
        0 AS revenue_total,
        0 AS revenue_channel,
        0 AS revenue_nature,
        0 AS revenue_gold,
        0 AS revenue_vip,
        0 AS user_consume_gold,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_no_vip_ids
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.app_id,
            p.page_key,
            COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic') AS channel
        FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r p
        LEFT JOIN paimon.dim.dim_user_snap dua
            ON p.app_id = dua.app_id
           AND p.uid = dua.uid
           AND dua.snap_dt = '${DT}'
        WHERE p.dt = '${DT}'
    ) p
    GROUP BY app_id, channel

    UNION ALL

    -- E. 注册
    SELECT
        app_id,
        channel,
        0 AS lp_pv,
        bm_empty() AS lp_uv,
        0 AS lp_click,
        0 AS video_view,
        0 AS app_entry,
        bm_union(uid) AS reg_all,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(device)) = 'IOS' THEN uid END) AS reg_ios,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(device)) = 'ANDROID' THEN uid END) AS reg_android,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(device)) = 'PC' THEN uid END) AS reg_pc,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(device)) NOT IN ('IOS', 'ANDROID', 'PC') THEN uid END) AS reg_other,
        bm_empty() AS login_all_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_non_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_gold_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_vip_ids,
        0 AS active_duration_total,
        0 AS order_launch_count,
        0 AS order_valid_count,
        0 AS revenue_total,
        0 AS revenue_channel,
        0 AS revenue_nature,
        0 AS revenue_gold,
        0 AS revenue_vip,
        0 AS user_consume_gold,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_no_vip_ids
    FROM (
        SELECT
            r.app_id,
            r.uid,
            r.device,
            COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic') AS channel
        FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2_r r
        LEFT JOIN paimon.dim.dim_user_snap dua
            ON r.app_id = dua.app_id
           AND r.uid = dua.uid
           AND dua.snap_dt = '${DT}'
        WHERE r.dt = '${DT}'
    ) r
    GROUP BY app_id, channel

    UNION ALL

    -- F. 登录与金币消耗
    SELECT
        app_id,
        channel,
        0 AS lp_pv,
        bm_empty() AS lp_uv,
        0 AS lp_click,
        0 AS video_view,
        0 AS app_entry,
        bm_empty() AS reg_all,
        bm_empty() AS reg_ios,
        bm_empty() AS reg_android,
        bm_empty() AS reg_pc,
        bm_empty() AS reg_other,
        login_all_ids,
        login_ios_ids,
        login_android_ids,
        login_pc_ids,
        login_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_non_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_gold_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_vip_ids,
        0 AS active_duration_total,
        0 AS order_launch_count,
        0 AS order_valid_count,
        0 AS revenue_total,
        0 AS revenue_channel,
        0 AS revenue_nature,
        0 AS revenue_gold,
        0 AS revenue_vip,
        user_consume_gold,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_no_vip_ids
    FROM (
        SELECT
            l.app_id,
            COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic') AS channel,
            bm_union(l.uid) AS login_all_ids,
            bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(l.device)) = 'IOS' THEN l.uid END) AS login_ios_ids,
            bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(l.device)) = 'ANDROID' THEN l.uid END) AS login_android_ids,
            bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(l.device)) = 'PC' THEN l.uid END) AS login_pc_ids,
            bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(l.device)) NOT IN ('IOS', 'ANDROID', 'PC') THEN l.uid END) AS login_other_ids,
            CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS user_consume_gold
        FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_user_login_d_v2_r l
        LEFT JOIN paimon.dim.dim_user_snap dua
            ON l.app_id = dua.app_id
           AND l.uid = dua.uid
           AND dua.snap_dt = '${DT}'
        WHERE l.dt = '${DT}'
        GROUP BY l.app_id, COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic')

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            c.app_id,
            COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic') AS channel,
            bm_empty() AS login_all_ids,
            bm_empty() AS login_ios_ids,
            bm_empty() AS login_android_ids,
            bm_empty() AS login_pc_ids,
            bm_empty() AS login_other_ids,
            SUM(COALESCE(c.coin_consume_amount, 0)) AS user_consume_gold
        FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_coin_consume_h_r c
        LEFT JOIN paimon.dim.dim_user_snap dua
            ON c.app_id = dua.app_id
           AND c.uid = dua.uid
           AND dua.snap_dt = '${DT}'
        WHERE c.dt = '${DT}'
        GROUP BY c.app_id, COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic')
    ) misc_tmp

    UNION ALL

    -- G. 活跃（UID）
    SELECT
        app_id,
        channel,
        0 AS lp_pv,
        bm_empty() AS lp_uv,
        0 AS lp_click,
        0 AS video_view,
        0 AS app_entry,
        bm_empty() AS reg_all,
        bm_empty() AS reg_ios,
        bm_empty() AS reg_android,
        bm_empty() AS reg_pc,
        bm_empty() AS reg_other,
        bm_empty() AS login_all_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_other_ids,
        bm_union(uid) AS dau_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_device)) = 'IOS' THEN uid END) AS dau_ios_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_device)) = 'ANDROID' THEN uid END) AS dau_android_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_device)) = 'PC' THEN uid END) AS dau_pc_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_device)) NOT IN ('IOS', 'ANDROID', 'PC') THEN uid END) AS dau_other_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_user_type)) = 'VIP' THEN uid END) AS dau_vip_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_user_type)) = 'NORMAL' THEN uid END) AS dau_non_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_gold_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_vip_ids,
        0 AS active_duration_total,
        0 AS order_launch_count,
        0 AS order_valid_count,
        0 AS revenue_total,
        0 AS revenue_channel,
        0 AS revenue_nature,
        0 AS revenue_gold,
        0 AS revenue_vip,
        0 AS user_consume_gold,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_no_vip_ids
    FROM uid_attribution
    GROUP BY app_id, channel, uid, final_user_type, final_device

    UNION ALL

    -- H. 活跃（device_id）
    SELECT
        app_id,
        channel,
        0 AS lp_pv,
        bm_empty() AS lp_uv,
        0 AS lp_click,
        0 AS video_view,
        0 AS app_entry,
        bm_empty() AS reg_all,
        bm_empty() AS reg_ios,
        bm_empty() AS reg_android,
        bm_empty() AS reg_pc,
        bm_empty() AS reg_other,
        bm_empty() AS login_all_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_non_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_gold_ids,
        bm_empty() AS pay_user_vip_ids,
        0 AS active_duration_total,
        0 AS order_launch_count,
        0 AS order_valid_count,
        0 AS revenue_total,
        0 AS revenue_channel,
        0 AS revenue_nature,
        0 AS revenue_gold,
        0 AS revenue_vip,
        0 AS user_consume_gold,
        bm_union(device_id) AS dad_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_device)) = 'IOS' THEN device_id END) AS dad_ios_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_device)) = 'ANDROID' THEN device_id END) AS dad_android_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_device)) = 'PC' THEN device_id END) AS dad_pc_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_device)) NOT IN ('IOS', 'ANDROID', 'PC') THEN device_id END) AS dad_other_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_user_type)) = 'VIP' THEN device_id END) AS dad_vip_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(final_user_type)) = 'NORMAL' THEN device_id END) AS dad_no_vip_ids
    FROM did_attribution
    GROUP BY app_id, channel, device_id, final_user_type, final_device

    UNION ALL

    -- I. 交易
    SELECT
        app_id,
        channel,
        0 AS lp_pv,
        bm_empty() AS lp_uv,
        0 AS lp_click,
        0 AS video_view,
        0 AS app_entry,
        bm_empty() AS reg_all,
        bm_empty() AS reg_ios,
        bm_empty() AS reg_android,
        bm_empty() AS reg_pc,
        bm_empty() AS reg_other,
        bm_empty() AS login_all_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS login_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dau_non_vip_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN ev = 'paid' THEN uid END) AS pay_user_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN ev = 'paid' AND order_type = 'coin_purchase' THEN uid END) AS pay_user_gold_ids,
        bm_union(CASE WHEN ev = 'paid' AND order_type = 'vip_subscription' THEN uid END) AS pay_user_vip_ids,
        0 AS active_duration_total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ev = 'created' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_launch_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ev = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_valid_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ev = 'paid' AND currency = 'CNY' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_total,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN ev = 'paid' AND currency = 'CNY'
                 AND channel NOT IN ('', 'organic') AND channel IS NOT NULL
                THEN amount ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS revenue_channel,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN ev = 'paid' AND currency = 'CNY'
                 AND (channel IN ('', 'organic') OR channel IS NULL)
                THEN amount ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS revenue_nature,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ev = 'paid' AND currency = 'CNY' AND order_type = 'coin_purchase' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_gold,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ev = 'paid' AND currency = 'CNY' AND order_type = 'vip_subscription' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_vip,
        0 AS user_consume_gold,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_ios_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_android_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_pc_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_other_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_vip_ids,
        bm_empty() AS dad_no_vip_ids
    FROM (
        SELECT
            o.app_id,
            o.uid,
            'created' AS ev,
            CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS order_type,
            CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS currency,
            CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS amount,
            COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic') AS channel
        FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_order_created_h_r o
        LEFT JOIN paimon.dim.dim_user_snap dua
            ON o.app_id = dua.app_id
           AND o.uid = dua.uid
           AND dua.snap_dt = '${DT}'
        WHERE o.dt = '${DT}'

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            o.app_id,
            o.uid,
            'paid' AS ev,
            o.order_type,
            o.currency,
            CAST(o.amount AS BIGINT) AS amount,
            COALESCE(dua.channel, 'organic') AS channel
        FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_order_paid_d_r o
        LEFT JOIN paimon.dim.dim_user_snap dua
            ON o.app_id = dua.app_id
           AND o.uid = dua.uid
           AND dua.snap_dt = '${DT}'
        WHERE o.dt = '${DT}'
    ) trade_tmp
    GROUP BY app_id, channel
) t
GROUP BY t.app_id, t.channel;
